verdicts.rationale: The REST v2 insert endpoint at /v2/vectordb/entities/insert accepts arbitrary-sized data arrays without validating against the documented maximum limit of 100 entities per insert call (constraint milvus_range_entities_insert_001). Testing confirmed: (1) Original observation: inserting 101 entities succeeded with HTTP 200, insertCount: 101; (2) Falsification test: inserting 200 entities succeeded with HTTP 200, insertCount: 200; (3) Extreme test: inserting 500 entities also succeeded with HTTP 200, insertCount: 500. Source code analysis shows the handler directly sets req.NumRows = uint32(len(httpReq.Data)) at line 1267 without any upper bound validation. The restfulSizeMiddleware only collects metrics, it does not perform size validation. This is a Type1_IllegalSuccess defect where the API accepts inputs that violate documented constraints, returning success status for requests that should be rejected with HTTP 400 and an appropriate error message.
